readme: Pinned upstream sources for the derived manual marks in src/logos/manual.ts. `scripts/derive-marks.ts` reads only these files (never the network) and verifies every sha256 below before rebuilding the derived tiles.

zhipu-z.svg.note: Official zai-org/GLM-5 tile: a #2D2D2D rounded plate with the white Z glyph, drawn on a 30-unit grid. The <style> block is dead (only .st15 and .st23 are ever referenced) and is dropped along with the empty 图层_2 group; the plate rect is replaced by the repository's own rounded tile while the three Z shapes are kept verbatim.

gemini-aurora.svg.note: Official Lobe Gemini colour mark: one sparkle path painted four times, a flat #3186FF base plus green (#08B962), red (#F94543) and yellow (#FABC12) userSpaceOnUse ramps. Inlined tiles may not carry ids, so the composite is flattened into sampled flat regions over the unchanged official outline.
